hints.content: Let's consider each object and see if we can get an ellipse cross-section by slicing it diagonal to its base/face.

Here are all the cross-sections we can get by slicing the cone diagonal to its base:



[[☃ image 1]]

If we slice the cone not through the base, we get an ellipse.

options.alt: A cone with a rectangle moving from the base to the apex to show the cross sections. The rectangle is diagonal to the cone's base, so it makes varying sizes of ellipses, from largest to smallest. When the rectangle crosses the base, it makes a shape with one curved side and one straight side.

hints.content:
Here are all the cross-sections we can get by slicing the cube diagonal to one of its faces:



[[☃ image 1]]



[[☃ image 2]]

The cross-section is never an ellipse.

options.alt: A cube with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is parallel to an edge of the cube. The rectangle moves through the entire cube showing every possible cross-section. It cross-sections include a rectangle and a square.

A cube with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is not parallel to any side. The rectangle moves through the entire cube showing every possible cross-section. It cross-sections include a triangle, a parallelogram, a pentagon, and a hexagon.

hints.content:
Here are all the cross-sections we can get by slicing the cylinder diagonal to its base, not through the base itself:



[[☃ image 1]]

No matter where we slice the cylinder, the shape is always an ellipse.

options.alt: A cylinder with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is diagonal to a base of the cylinder. The rectangle moves through the entire cylinder showing every possible cross-section. It cross-section includes an ellipse.

hints.content:
Here are all the cross-sections we can get by slicing the sphere:


[[☃ image 1]]

The cross-section is always a circle.

options.alt: A sphere with a plane passing through it and showing every cross-section as it vertically passes through.

hints.content:
We can create ellipse cross-sections (that aren't circles) by slicing the following objects diagonal to their bases:

- Cone
- Cylinder
